registryEntry.label: Create Management Subnet
registryEntry.get_command: Get-AzVirtualNetwork -ResourceGroupName '{resourceGroup}' -Name '{vnetName}' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Subnets | Where-Object {$_.Name -eq 'snet-mgmt'} | Select-Object -First 1 Name, AddressPrefix | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3
registryEntry.set_command: $vnet = Get-AzVirtualNetwork -ResourceGroupName '{resourceGroup}' -Name '{vnetName}'; $existing = $vnet.Subnets | Where-Object {$_.Name -eq 'snet-mgmt'}; if (-not $existing) { Add-AzVirtualNetworkSubnetConfig -Name 'snet-mgmt' -VirtualNetwork $vnet -AddressPrefix '{mgmtSubnetCidr}' | Set-AzVirtualNetwork } else { Write-Output 'snet-mgmt subnet already exists' }
evidence_commands: Get-AzVirtualNetwork -ResourceGroupName '{resourceGroup}' -Name '{vnetName}' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Subnets | Select-Object Name, AddressPrefix

metadata.commandExecuted: $vnet = Get-AzVirtualNetwork -ResourceGroupName '{resourceGroup}' -Name '{vnetName}'; $existing = $vnet.Subnets | Where-Object {$_.Name -eq 'snet-mgmt'}; if (-not $existing) { Add-AzVirtualNetworkSubnetConfig -Name 'snet-mgmt' -VirtualNetwork $vnet -AddressPrefix '{mgmtSubnetCidr}' | Set-AzVirtualNetwork } else { Write-Output 'snet-mgmt subnet already exists' }
